messages.content: tell That you are you so dignifies his story Let him but copy what in you is writ Not making worse what nature made so clear And such a counterpart shall fame his wit Making his style admired every where You to your beauteous blessings add a curse Being fond on praise which makes your praises worse 85 My tonguetied muse in manners holds her still While comments of your praise richly compiled Reserve their character with golden quill And precious phrase by all the Muses filed I think
